facts.value: 'The total number of tentative vacancies is 84.' Vacancies were still being collected; post-wise and category-wise vacancies were to follow on the Commission's Tentative Vacancy page. State/zone-wise vacancies are not collected by SSC.

label.hi: क्या पद समूह ख के हैं?

facts.value: Yes — Group 'B' Non-Gazetted posts: Junior Hindi Translator, Junior Translation Officer, Junior Translator, Senior Hindi Translator and Senior Translation Officer.

A = Junior Translation Officer (JTO) in CSOLS, Level-6 (₹35,400–1,12,400); B = JTO in Armed Forces Headquarters (AFHQ), Level-6; C = Junior Hindi Translator/JTO/Junior Translator in various Ministries/Departments/Organizations, Level-6; D = Senior Hindi Translator/Senior Translator/Senior Translation Officer, Level-7 (₹44,900–1,42,400).

label.en: Qualification, post codes A to C
label.hi: योग्यता, पद कोड A से C

facts.value: Master's degree in Hindi with English as a compulsory/elective subject or as the medium of examination at degree level, or the reverse, or the four other prescribed combinations — AND a recognized Diploma/Certificate course in translation from Hindi to English and vice versa, or two years' experience of translation work (Hindi↔English) in a Central/State Government office including a Government of India Undertaking.
Same Master's degree combinations — AND a recognized Diploma/Certificate course in translation, or three years' translation experience of the same kind.
The Essential Educational Qualification must be possessed on 01.08.2026; the result of the qualifying examination must have been declared on or before that date.

Only male candidates are eligible for the vacancies, if any, reported in the Border Roads Organization (BRO); BRO posts also carry physical standards/efficiency and medical standards at Annexure-XIII.
18 to 30 years as on 01-08-2026, i.e. candidates born not before 02-08-1996 and not later than 01-08-2008.

SC/ST 5 years; OBC 3 years; PwBD 10 years; PwBD (OBC) 13 years; PwBD (SC/ST) 15 years; Ex-servicemen 3 years after deduction of military service; Defence personnel disabled in hostilities 3 years (8 years if SC/ST).

₹100/- (Rupees one hundred only). Women, SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-servicemen eligible for reservation are exempted. Online only (BHIM UPI, Net Banking, Visa/MasterCard/Maestro/RuPay debit card); fee once paid is not refunded.
Two papers: Paper-I (Objective, Computer Based Mode) and Paper-II (Descriptive — Translation & Essay).
Descriptive: two passages for translation (one Hindi→English, one English→Hindi) and an essay each in Hindi and English — 200 marks, 2 hours (2 hours 40 minutes for scribe-eligible candidates).
50% of Paper-I scores and 100% of Paper-II marks; separate category-wise cut-offs may apply in each paper. FRTA/final allocation is on merit-cum-preference of posts/departments.
Understanding of the languages and literature, correct use of words, phrases and idioms, and ability to write the languages correctly, precisely and effectively; questions of degree level.

Multi-shift CBE scores normalised as per the Notice dated 02-06-2025; answer-key challenges online only, ₹50/- per question (2026 notice), ₹50/- per question/answer in the 21.09.2026 notice; no re-evaluation or re-checking at any stage.
